claims.hypothesis: Can the CO gas around 49 Cet and HD 32297 be explained by a secondary (non-primordial) shielded gas disk model?
claims.experiment: Measured 13CO and C18O with the ALMA 7-m array, derived CO masses, and fitted the upgraded shielded secondary gas model grid to the 13CO (49 Cet) and C18O (HD 32297) masses, inner CO radius, and CI flux.
claims.result: Parameter region with alpha about 2e-5 to 9e-5 and CO production 0.004 to 0.006 M_earth/Myr satisfies all 49 Cet constraints; HD 32297 needs alpha of 1.5e-5 with production of 3.6e-2 M_earth/Myr.
claims.finding: Both disks can be explained by a shielded secondary gas disk model without primordial material; the fit for HD 32297 is more marginal.

evidence.quote: we can explain the observed CO level in both systems.
we found that there exists a region in the parameter space

claims.hypothesis: Are the CO-rich disks shielded by CO self-shielding or by C0 shielding beyond what is needed?
claims.experiment: Computed the minimum shielding factor from a steady-state CO production budget and compared with vertical CO column densities.
claims.result: Shielding factors of about 3600 (49 Cet) and 400 (HD 32297) are required; self-shielding alone is sufficient only in HD 32297 and HD 121617, and even there more shielding is needed.
claims.finding: CO-rich disks require substantial shielding (epsilon above 100), so they are shielded debris disks.

referee_caveats_inferred: The paper gives two different ALMA project codes (2016.2.00200.S in Observations and 2017.2.00200.S in Acknowledgments); the archive link lists only 2016.2.00200.S.
The 1.33 mm continuum and CO fluxes are not corrected for the gas excitation or beam dilution; the excitation temperature of 20 K is adopted, not derived.
The 1-D shielded model is described as to be presented in a forthcoming paper, so the new model cannot be checked from this text alone.
Dust opacity, CO-to-H2 and isotope-ratio assumptions carry large systematic uncertainties not in the quoted errors.
The HD 32297 model fit is described as marginal and depends on very low alpha values.
